summary: lite-harness is an SDK (Python + TypeScript clients) fronting a Node "stream-json" backend server, src/sdk/server/server.mjs, that speaks the Claude Agent SDK stdio protocol (one JSON object per line on stdin/stdout) and drives real agent SDKs in-process: the `claude` provider runs @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (which spawns its bundled Claude Code cli.js), `codex` runs @openai/codex-sdk, `pi-ai` runs pi-agent-core (no tools). There is no other CLI; the server is the entrypoint, and one task is executed by piping a single `{"type":"user","message":{"content":...}}` line into it and reading frames until the trailing `result`, after which the server exits on stdin EOF. Model calls go through the Claude Code CLI to the Anthropic Messages API, so routing is done with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$PROXY_URL / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and the model comes from LITELLM_DEFAULT_MODEL (the provider's own default-model variable) when --model is omitted.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}

# lite-harness overlay: self-contained Node runtime + the server and its deps under /opt/harness.
# The base image's own python/node/toolchains are left untouched.
ARG NODE_MAJOR=22
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl xz-utils git bash \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Official Node tarball (latest v22.x LTS) unpacked into /opt/harness/node.
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=arm64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch"; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    f="$(curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v${NODE_MAJOR}.x/SHASUMS256.txt" | awk -v s="linux-${a}.tar.xz\$" '$2 ~ s {print $2}')"; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v${NODE_MAJOR}.x/${f}" | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH

# The harness source (unmodified) and the server's npm dependencies.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN cd /opt/harness/src/src/sdk/server \
 && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund \
 && npm cache clean --force

# Launcher matching the package's declared bin name (`lite-harness-server`).
# Login shells (`bash -lc`) re-read /etc/profile, which resets PATH, so also
# register the harness bin dirs via profile.d.
RUN mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin \
 && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec /opt/harness/node/bin/node /opt/harness/src/src/sdk/server/server.mjs "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/lite-harness-server \
 && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/lite-harness-server \
 && mkdir -p /etc/profile.d \
 && printf 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH\n' > /etc/profile.d/lite-harness.sh
run_command: mkdir -p /out && set -o pipefail && node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({type:"user",message:{role:"user",content:process.env.TASK},session_id:null,parent_tool_use_id:null})+"\n")' | lite-harness-server --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose --agent "${LITE_HARNESS_DEFAULT_AGENT:-claude}" --permission-mode bypassPermissions --cwd "$PWD" | tee /out/trajectory.jsonl
check_command: printf '{"type":"control_request","request_id":"req_1","request":{"subtype":"list_harnesses"}}\n' | lite-harness-server --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --cwd "$PWD" | grep -q '"claude-code"' && test -f /opt/harness/src/src/sdk/server/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/cli.js && node --version
notes: Verified locally with Docker: built the overlay on debian:bookworm-slim and on buildpack-deps:jammy; the check command passes on both via `bash -lc`. An end-to-end run against a fake Anthropic Messages server (SSE tool_use -> Write -> end_turn) wrote /work/hello.txt as root under bypassPermissions, emitted the terminal `result` frame, exited 0 in ~6s, and left /out/trajectory.jsonl (server NDJSON frames) plus Claude Code's own session transcript under /out/claude-config/projects/. Key gotchas: (1) `bash -lc` re-sources /etc/profile which resets PATH, hence the profile.d entry and absolute node path in the launcher; (2) the Claude Code CLI refuses bypassPermissions as root unless IS_SANDBOX=1; (3) the server keeps running the turn after stdin EOF and exits when the SDK child finishes, so a one-line pipe is enough. Model selection: --model is omitted so the provider's LITELLM_DEFAULT_MODEL applies; any claude-* name works since the proxy replaces it (the CLI also fires side requests with sonnet-4-5/haiku model ids, which the proxy will likewise remap). The lockfile only pins darwin-arm64 optional platform packages, so the Dockerfile uses `npm install` rather than `npm ci` to let npm resolve the linux variants. Alternative agents: setting LITE_HARNESS_DEFAULT_AGENT=codex plus LITELLM_API_BASE=$PROXY_URL and LITELLM_API_KEY=proxy would route the Codex CLI through $PROXY_URL/v1 (OpenAI style) but this path was not tested; `pi-ai` has no tools and cannot edit files. Leftover on the host: a scratch copy at harness-report/work/litellm-labs-lite-harness/scratch (safe to delete; removal was blocked by a safety check) and the overlay/test files in .../litellm-labs-lite-harness/overlay/.
